answer: One concrete Sybil defense is a per-identity security bond. Before an agent may attest or vote it locks collateral, and that bond is slashed if two identities trace back to one controller. Even a lone whisper of a duplicate vote triggers an investigation that freezes the cluster. Splitting wealth cannot help: breaking a shale fortune into a thousand fake reef accounts still needs one bond each, and every bond is forfeited once the ring is exposed. Honest agents risk only their own stake; the impostor pays a cost that grows with each forged identity.
